title: Fourteen African countries, key partners unite to provide critical resources for health in WHO’s first-ever Investment Round
excerpt: In an unprecedented show of unity in support of the World Health Organization, 14 African countries and many partners pledged over US$ 45 million to the WHO Investment Round, a three-month-old initiative aimed at generating sustainable financing for the organization at the center of the global health architecture.
